properties.name: security.jwt.secret-key
properties.description: 256-bits (32 bytes) key, encoded with BASE64URL. Used to sign and verify JWT tokens (HMAC).

properties.name: security.jwt.expiration-time
properties.description: Time for the token JWT to expire in milisseconds.

properties.name: security.cookie.expiration-time
properties.description: Time for the Secure Cookie in frontend to expire in seconds (max-age attribute).

properties.name: security.reset-password.expiration-time
properties.description: Time for the uuid reset password token expire in seconds.

properties.name: frontend.base-url
properties.description: Base url of the frontend application.
